concerns.text: T004's checkpoint command is `python code/main.py --stage connectivity --seed 42`, but `code/main.py` is not implemented until T009. This is a consumer-before-producer ordering violation: the T004 checkpoint cannot be executed when T004 completes. Either move the orchestrator skeleton (or at least the `--stage connectivity` entry point) into T004, or restate the checkpoint as a direct invocation of `code/connectivity.py`.
